# flightblog.justinverstijnen.nl

> Personal aviation blog by Justin Verstijnen about flight training, aviation theory and the journey towards a Private Pilot License (PPL).

## Main sections
- Home: https://flightblog.justinverstijnen.nl/
- Blog: https://flightblog.justinverstijnen.nl/blog/
- About: https://flightblog.justinverstijnen.nl/about/
- Flight Tools: https://flighttools.justinverstijnen.nl/

## Main subjects
- Private Pilot License (PPL)
- Flight training
- Cessna 172
- Aviation theory
- Microsoft Flight Simulator
